statements.quote: High Performance Computing & Artificial Intelligence (“HPC & AI”) revenue was $862 million, down 14% from the prior-year period in actual dollars and 11% when adjusted for currency, with 3.5% operating profit margin, compared to 14.2% from the prior-year period.
statements.notes: Figure is for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2022 only, not the full year. It is the HPC & AI segment's revenue, which includes supercomputing and HPC sales that are not AI, so it overstates the AI part. The full-year HPC & AI segment revenue of $3,192 million appears only in segment tables (p04, p05), not in a sentence, so it is not recorded.
